name: spicy-discount-searcher
description: Chrome/Brave extension that races corporate discount codes against each other to find the cheapest rental car or hotel rate.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:content && npm run build:reset
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/check-dist.mjs && npm audit --audit-level=moderate
